scope: Python-only approach skill for initially visible interactables; no new native RPC/primitive
qualification: TESTED in deterministic planner/interaction fixtures and MCP discovery; graphical gameplay UNVERIFIED
contracts: AR01 distant/frontier approach, guarded movement and no use
AR02 nearest locally approachable selection and exact visible position override
AR03 no hidden-coordinate lookup or unsupported route
AR04 target loss/replacement without silent retarget
AR05 exact native ID/position observed before success
AR08 hazards, damage, stuck and collision detour
AR13 negative/off-center coordinates and schema boundaries
preserved: Existing native TLS/authentication/trust, F8 and bounded leases remain unchanged.
No automatic use/open/attack, inventory access or transfer.
Position selects among bounded initially visible interactables, not arbitrary world coordinates.
All movement uses native collision mesh and guarded look/drive; partial surfaces are not treated as free space.
Autopilot retains its default one-tick pulses; approach opts into at most three ticks through the shared motor.
Status/cancel remain responsive and final input release is attempted.
limits: Flat full-block terrain only; local/frontier routing is not global reachability proof.
Visibility/native hit/navigation snapshots are client-predicted and non-atomic.
Block identity is registry ID plus position, not immutable container identity.
Damage avoidance is best effort; short native pulses can overshoot observation thresholds.
No live graphical, modpack, real-time or release qualification.
